leadText: Yosuke Akimoto (秋元羊介 Akimoto Yōsuke) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Yosuke Akimoto (秋元羊介 Akimoto Yōsuke) is a Japanese voice actor for . 

==Biography==
Akimoto was born Yukio Tajika (田鹿幸雄 Tajika Yukio) on February 5, 1944 in , . He started his work on during the , where he voiced Sabrina's father. In , his role was Mr. Briney. However, his most prominent role was during the first movie and its radio drama prequel The Birth of Mewtwo.
